sponsored.t: Relates to modernizing the chiropractic scope of practice; repealer
sponsored.sum: Expands the scope of chiropractic practice.

sponsored.t: Requires a lethality assessment in incidents of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Requires law enforcement officers to conduct a lethality assessment as part of the standardized domestic incident report form when responding to incidents of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "right to home inspection act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the right to inspection of homes by buyers; provides for a 10-day inspection period where the buyer has the right to have a home inspected and cancel the contract if the buyer is not satisfied with the inspection results; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires colleges, universities, professional, proprietary, and graduate schools to provide a notice of tuition liability policies
sponsored.sum: Requires colleges, universities, professional, proprietary and graduate schools to provide written notice to all students of the institution's tuition liability policy.

sponsored.t: Relates to caregiver requirements for certain day care homes
sponsored.sum: Requires one caregiver for every two children under eighteen months of age in group family day care homes and family day care homes.

sponsored.t: Requires immediate notification of a child's parent when an allegation of child abuse in an educational setting has been made regarding such child
sponsored.sum: Requires immediate notification of a child's parent when an allegation of child abuse in an educational setting has been made regarding such child.

sponsored.t: Requires the municipal police training council establish a use of force policy for companion animals
sponsored.sum: Requires the municipal police training council establish a use of force policy for companion animals; defines companion animals.

sponsored.t: Expands the type of certifications that may be accepted by the state of New York for restricted licenses
sponsored.sum: Expands the type of certifications that may be accepted by the state of New York for restricted licenses; requires individuals may only perform toxicology testing in a laboratory authorized by the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires certain establishments provide tap water on request
sponsored.sum: Requires certain establishments provide tap water on request.

sponsored.t: Renames the block grant for child care to the early childhood fund and requires the office of children and family services administer such fund
sponsored.sum: Renames the block grant for child care to the early childhood fund; requires the office of children and family services administer such fund; expands who qualifies for guaranteed child care assistance.

sponsored.t: Creates the Checkout NY pass
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Creates the "Checkout NY" pass, a comprehensive pass that allows for free or discounted use of state parks, historic sites and recreational facilities; provides one such pass to each consolidated, federated and cooperative public library system within the state free of charge for circulation.

sponsored.t: Prohibits ticket sales that exceed the capacity of a place of entertainment or not-for-profit venue
sponsored.sum: Prohibits ticket sales that exceed the capacity of a place of entertainment or not-for-profit venue; provides that a violation of such provisions constitutes a misdemeanor punishable by a fine and imprisonment for a period not to exceed one year.

sponsored.t: Establishes an animal abuser registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes an animal abuser registry; requires background checks for pet store and animal shelter licenses.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the eligibility for the New York opportunity promise scholarship
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the eligibility for the New York opportunity promise scholarship to prevent people from applying if they previously received a postsecondary degree within a certain timeframe.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program by restoring eligibility to graduate students; makes optional semesters, quarters or terms eligible for awards.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of criminal justice services to promulgate safety standards and training requirements for the protection of law enforcement against biological hazards posed by certain persons in custody
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of criminal justice services to promulgate safety standards and training requirements for the protection of law enforcement staff against biological hazards posed by spitting of persons in custody.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Rochester to adopt a local law requiring police officers in such city to be residents of Rochester
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Rochester to adopt a local law requiring a member of the police force in such city to be a resident of Rochester subsequent to the effective date of such local law.

sponsored.t: Relates to publishing of common data sets reported by colleges
sponsored.sum: Requires colleges to publish responses to the survey created by the Common Data Set Initiative, relating to admissions and financial aid process, annual expenses, academic offerings, graduation rate, student demographics, instructional faculty and class sizes, and degrees conferred, on an annual basis.

sponsored.t: Enacts the lab services accessibility act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the lab services accessibility act.

sponsored.t: Permits certain not-for-profit corporations engaged in engineering for certain conservation efforts to do business or provide professional engineering, land surveying or professional geology services in the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting certain not-for-profit corporations engaged in engineering for certain conservation efforts to do business or provide professional engineering, land surveying, or professional geology services in the state.

sponsored.t: Requires certain municipal planning boards and zoning boards of appeals to receive environmentally conscious planning training
sponsored.sum: Requires certain municipal planning boards and zoning boards of appeals to receive at least one hour of environmentally conscious planning training annually.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring guidance counselors in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior high and senior high school
sponsored.sum: Requires at least one full-time guidance counselor to be employed in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior and senior high school throughout the state; sets duties of guidance counselors.

sponsored.t: Implements a cost estimation model for child care
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of children and family services to utilize a cost estimation model when determining the actual cost providers incur when providing child care; requires the office to prepare a report detailing such.

sponsored.t: Provides for coordination between the department of health and the state long-term care ombudsperson regarding residential health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Provides for coordination between the department of health and the state long-term care ombudsperson regarding residential health care facilities, including such facilities' compliance with state and federal law, and histories of complaints.

sponsored.t: Provides for the protection of the air quality at day care centers licensed by the state and head start day care centers funded pursuant to federal law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the protection of the air quality at licensed day care centers and head start day care centers funded pursuant to federal law; requires the office of children and family services to consult with the commissioners of environmental conservation and health regarding the air quality and environmental hazards that may be involved with any new day care center or head start day care center; requires such office to consult with the department of health if any new environmental or environmental health hazard arises.

sponsored.t: Removes limits on licensed physical therapists treating patients without a referral
sponsored.sum: Removes limits on the duration of treatment by a licensed physical therapist when a patient does not have a referral.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state university of New York pilot program to encourage individuals in college to enter the financial planning industry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state university of New York career pilot program to encourage individuals in college to enter the financial planning industry; utilizes campus resources to encourage a well-rounded program and diverse student involvement.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding fetal alcohol spectrum disorders to the definition of developmental disability
sponsored.sum: Adds fetal alcohol spectrum disorders to the definition of developmental disability.

sponsored.t: Implements automatic market rate increases for child care assistance
sponsored.sum: Implements automatic market rate increases for child care assistance such that assistance will be equal to the applicable payment rate established by the department.

sponsored.t: Relates to certified medication aides
sponsored.sum: Provides for certified medication aides to administer certain medications in residential health care facilities.

sponsored.t: Provides for the regulation by the department of environmental conservation of business transaction paper containing bisphenol A
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the distribution and use of paper containing bisphenol A for the recording of any business transaction.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain income for the purpose of determining aid provided pursuant to public assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Exempts aid derived from funding from childcare stabilization grants, childcare desert funding, or other non-recurring funding, issued by the office of children and family services to childcare providers from income for the purpose of determining aid provided pursuant to public assistance programs.

sponsored.t: Prohibits employers from asking job applicants about salary expectations and allowing job applicants to request the included benefits for the position they are applying for
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from asking job applicants about salary expectations; allows job applicants to request the included benefits for the position they are applying for.

sponsored.t: Establishes the early learning child care act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Early Learning Child Care Act to impose a payroll tax on certain employers for the purposes of addressing child care affordability, accessibility, and quality for families with children under five years of age; establishes the early learning child care fund; establishes the early learning child care program to provide subsidies to covered children to attend early learning child care programs; establishes the New York state child care board.

sponsored.t: Establishes a course of study in financial education for certain students
sponsored.sum: Establishes a half-credit course in financial education delivered by means of a comprehensive financial literacy program for all pupils in grades nine, ten, eleven or twelve.

sponsored.t: Relates to dental laboratories
sponsored.sum: Relates to dental laboratories; defines terms; requires any dental laboratory operating, doing business, or intending to operate or do business in this state to register with the department of health; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of the child welfare advocate
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of the child welfare advocate to provide support to youth, biological parents, kinship caregivers and foster parents including prospective kinship caregivers or foster parents.

sponsored.t: Establishes and funds the close the waitlist fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes and funds the close the waitlist fund by utilizing a tax surcharge to pay for providing senior services to individuals who have been waitlisted to receive such senior services.

sponsored.t: Provides for mental health screening and creating a presumption that post-traumatic stress disorder is proximately caused by employment for law enforcement officers and emergency medical personnel
sponsored.sum: Provides for mental health screening; creates a presumption that post-traumatic stress disorder is proximately caused by employment for law enforcement officers and emergency medical services personnel.

sponsored.t: Establishes the baby bucks allowance
sponsored.sum: Establishes the baby bucks allowance to provide income to eligible participants for the last three months of pregnancy and the first 18 months of the child's life; excludes income received from the baby bucks allowance for purposes of supplemental nutrition assistance program eligibility.

sponsored.t: Requires reporting to the federal bureau of investigation's national use-of-force data collection program
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice services to report to the federal bureau of investigation's national use-of-force data collection program.

sponsored.t: Provides for self-attestation for victims of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Provides for self-attestation for victims of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Prohibits requiring parents or caretakers to earn a minimum wage or work a minimum number of hours to be eligible for child care assistance
sponsored.sum: Prohibits requiring parents or caretakers to earn a minimum wage to be eligible for child care assistance.

sponsored.t: Establishes a registry of substitute staff for child care providers
sponsored.sum: Requires child care resource and referral program participants to establish registries of substitute staff for child care providers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for grocery donations to food pantries
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for grocery donations to food pantries.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the retail sale of spices that exceed lead level limits
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the retail sale of spices that exceed lead level limits; defines spices and types of spices; establishes acceptable lead limits for various types of spices.

sponsored.t: Establishes the right to inspection of residential real properties
sponsored.sum: Establishes the right to inspection of residential real properties, condominium units, and cooperative apartments.

sponsored.t: Relates to lead testing of children participating in the WIC program
sponsored.sum: Requires lead testing of children participating in the WIC program.

sponsored.t: Requires a minimum operator age for amusement devices
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of labor to promulgate rules and regulations to authorize competent operators at least sixteen years of age to operate all amusement devices.

sponsored.t: Directs school districts to establish parent advisory councils on special education
sponsored.sum: Directs school districts to establish parent advisory councils on special education to advise on matters that pertain to the education and safety of students with disabilities, and meet regularly with school officials to participate in the planning, development, and evaluation of the school district's special education programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to fees for non-driver identification cards
sponsored.sum: Provides for the waiver of fees for non-driver identification cards for certain individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to caregiver requirements for certain day care homes
sponsored.sum: Requires one caregiver for every two children under eighteen months of age in group family day care homes and family day care homes.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 103 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 4003, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to caregiver requirements for certain day care homes" NOT APPROVED This bill would change staffing ratios for certain infants in home- based day care programs. Specifically, it would change the requirement to have one caregiver for every two infants under 24 months to require one caregiver for every two infants under 18 months. For children 18 to 24 months, the ratio could become as low as one caregiver for every six infants under this bill. The current staffing ratios set forth by the Office of Children and Family Services are based on the recommendations of national experts on fire and child safety. sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the reasonable accommodation anti-retaliation act
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting retaliation against individuals who request a reasonable accommodation.

sponsored.t: Relates to maternal health care and birthing best practices; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to evaluate and make recommendations related to maternal health care and birthing best practices; repeals certain provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the statewide presumptive eligibility standard for the receipt of child care assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to the statewide presumptive eligibility standard; authorizes local social services districts to utilize child care block grant funds for the presumptive eligibility period to the extent permitted by federal law; amends the effectiveness thereof.
